bubble_center_x: fixed coordinate, not a differentiated parameter
future_path: metric.evaluate(t, x, y, z, params) already accepts t; TimeTreatment::MovingBubble is the unimplemented branch that will use x_s(t)
time_treatment_meaning: The bubble centre is held at a fixed coordinate and d_t g_{mu nu} == 0 by construction. These results are a SPATIAL SLICE of a moving spacetime, not the moving spacetime. Curvature computed from this slice alone is NOT the complete physical Alcubierre spacetime curvature.
